title: Alignment Plan Bundle Points on Counter Replacements
content:
An Alignment Services & Plans plan held on the vehicle adds bundle points to the coverage percentage of a replacement a Crestline store carried out at its counter and posted to a Road Hazard Protection certificate.

**Counter-replacement bundle points.** A vehicle with a Crestline alignment plan in status active that was sold on the certificate's own purchase ticket adds 4 points to the counter-replacement coverage percentage; a vehicle with an active Crestline alignment plan sold on a different ticket adds 2 points; a vehicle with no active alignment plan adds no bundle points.

| Active alignment plan on the vehicle | Sold on | Points |
|---|---|---|
| yes | the certificate's own purchase ticket | 4 |
| yes | a different ticket | 2 |
| no | — | 0 |

*Hypothetical case.* A vehicle whose active alignment plan was sold on the same ticket as the certificate adds 4 points; one whose active plan was bought on a later ticket adds 2.
